title: useSubmit
summary: Submit programmatically through the page router.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: The hook takes no arguments and requires RouterProvider. Its returned function accepts a Submission and SubmissionOptions. Use a registered route URL in options.action; the default is the current snapshot URL.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: For GET, returns the navigation promise. For POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE, returns the router submission promise with a Result. Methods are normalized to uppercase and default to POST. Page action results are read through useActionData; independent forms should generally use useFetcher instead.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: An imperative GET replaces the destination query string with the submitted fields and navigates to that route’s loader.

sections.title: Body encoding and navigation options
sections.body: FormData is preserved, an HTMLFormElement becomes FormData, and object fields are stringified. application/json encoding stores JSON in a _payload form field for readSubmission. Pass action and method explicitly when submitting a form element: its HTML action, method, and clicked submit button are not inspected here. replace and preventScrollReset are forwarded for GET navigation; they are not forwarded by this hook for mutations.
